_meta.dataset: MICHELIN Guide New York City — Non-Starred Guide-Listed Selection (Bib Gourmand & Selected) + Full 369-Entry Directory Reconciliation
_meta.ceremony_2026_note: Michelin North America announced on 2026-08-11 that the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Northeast Cities ceremony takes place on 2026-12-14 at The Glasshouse in New York City. Re-verify all distinctions after 2026-12-14 before Feb–Mar 2027 bookings.
_meta.nr01_reconciliation: Resolves NR-01: the live MICHELIN all-starred directory displays 5 three-star (Eleven Madison Park, Jungsik New York, Le Bernardin, Per Se, Sushi Sho), 14 two-star, and 50 one-star entries, summing to exactly 69 starred restaurants (matching the '1-48 of 69 restaurants' heading). Combined with 76 Bib Gourmand and 224 Selected (listed-only) venues, the live NYC directory totals 369 restaurants (69 + 76 + 224 = 369).
_meta.price_arithmetic_rule: Prix-fixe rows use 2 × a published per-person price; à-la-carte rows show explicit example orders. Subtotals exclude beverages, tax and gratuity unless stated and are not 2027 quotes. Nyonya menu ownership is not independently confirmed; Nyonya, Nami Nori and Ruffian prices remain unverified.

clusters.name: Flatiron / NoMad / Gramercy / Union Square
clusters.cluster_summary: Descriptive neighborhood grouping only; no hotel-to-restaurant journey time is implied. Highest walking-radius concentration of both starred and Guide-listed (Selected + Bib Gourmand) dining in Manhattan along the 14th–32nd St / Broadway–Park Ave spine.

clusters.name: Midtown / Fifth Ave / Theater District
nearest_candidate_hotels: Blue Angel Hotel NYC (152 E 55th St)
clusters.cluster_summary: Descriptive neighborhood grouping only; no hotel-to-restaurant journey time is implied. Densest three-star and two-star fine-dining corridor (Le Bernardin, Per Se, Sushi Sho, The Modern, Gabriel Kreuther, Aquavit) paired with hotel-accessible Selected dining such as Ai Fiori on Fifth Ave.

clusters.name: West Village / Greenwich Village
clusters.cluster_summary: Descriptive neighborhood grouping only; no hotel-to-restaurant journey time is implied. High-demand neighborhood cluster reachable on the 1/2/3, A/C/E, and F/M lines; combines 1-star counters with Selected Italian-American (Don Angie) and Bib Gourmand temaki (Nami Nori).

clusters.name: SoHo / Nolita / Chinatown / Little Italy
clusters.cluster_summary: Descriptive neighborhood grouping only; no hotel-to-restaurant journey time is implied. Best high-value Bib Gourmand daytime and casual dinner cluster along Mott and Grand Streets (N/Q/R/W, B/D, 6, J/Z).

clusters.name: East Village / Lower East Side
clusters.cluster_summary: Descriptive neighborhood grouping only; no hotel-to-restaurant journey time is implied. Adventurous Bib Gourmand destination cluster anchored by Essex Market (Dhamaka, F/M/J/Z Delancey-Essex) and East 7th St natural wine bars (Ruffian).

clusters.name: Tribeca & Financial District
clusters.cluster_summary: Descriptive neighborhood grouping only; no hotel-to-restaurant journey time is implied. Walkable from Lower Manhattan hotels: combines 3-star Jungsik, 2-star Atera/Saga, and 1-star Crown Shy with 60th-floor skyline dining at Manhatta and townhouse tasting menus at One White Street.
